ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: World Domination Patch
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Version: v0.2.0
Compatibility patch: World Domination 2.0 bases, turrets and travelers are classified, populated and owned under Regions and Societies territory rules.
Features: - Typed sorting: travelers (raids, drop pods, road builders, purchase parties) count as caravans; WD outposts hold ground as outposts. - World Domination stays authoritative: this patch classifies WD objects under Regions and Societies territory rules but never resizes them - WD's own settlement grades and outpost mechanics are untouched. - Turrets hold ground: automated turrets classify as military installations that hold territory. - Ruins release territory: a destroyed World Domination settlement becomes scenery and stops claiming its region.
Requires: Regions and Societies (either the standard or the Realistic Planets 2 edition) and World Domination 2.0. No settings of its own - governance toggles live in Regions and Societies.
--- Changelog (v0.2.0) --- - Works with both Regions and Societies editions: the hard dependency on the standard edition is gone, so Realistic Planets 2 edition players no longer see a false "missing dependency" warning. With no edition loaded at all, the mod now logs a plain warning naming both editions instead of erroring. - World Domination stays authoritative: the patch classifies WD objects under territory rules but no longer resizes them - outposts no longer weigh their pawn count into Regions and Societies sizing, and WD's own settlement grades and mechanics are untouched. - Groundwork (dormant): the WD settlement grade -> territory tier mapping is implemented and ships disabled; it goes live in a future release after in-game validation.
Source: https://github.com/Regions-and-societies/World-Domination-CP Support development: https://ko-fi.com/archdukejim
